description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

B4Corp is hiring a ServiceNow-focused Software Engineer to provide development and operations and maintenance support for a customer’s ServiceNow platform. The role includes configuring and customizing the platform, developing workflows and integrations, administering the platform, and supporting its full software development lifecycle.
Software Engineer providing ServiceNow development and O&M support, customizing workflows, administering the platform, and integrating external systems

Responsibilities:
• The Customer provides development support to enable mission by delivering products and services to collect, analyze and manipulate data
• The Customer requires support specializing in software development to provide development and operations and maintenance (O&M) support to a ServiceNow platform used by the Customer’s organization to track requests, tasks, and metrics
• Work will include implementing configuration and customization of the platform to address the business needs of the Customer’s organization, as well as assisting the Customer in establishing governance and change management
• The Team will implement the full software development lifecycle to support the development of custom workflows in the ServiceNow platform and have a good understanding of the Customer’s ServiceNow business needs
• They will implement and customize ServiceNow solutions to meet the Customer’s mission requirements, be responsible for administration of the ServiceNow front-end, and provide O&M for the ServiceNow front-end
• They will also define data tables and business logic in the ServiceNow platform; provide administration of ServiceNow user roles, groups and permissions; and support data transformation activities to load information into the ServiceNow platform
• The team will manage the migration of update sets to sub-prod and prod environments, troubleshoot production problems related to the ServiceNow platform, and provide ServiceNow integration support with external systems and data sources
• They will also provide development support to applications that will interface with the ServiceNow platform to ensure a seamless integration and work with a team to develop and deploy custom workflows, including the Customer project manager, systems engineer(s), system architect(s) and system integrator(s)
• The team should be prepared to follow an agile software development methodology for planning, implementing and delivering ServiceNow capabilities

Requirements:
• Position Requires a Top Secret (TS/SCI) Clearance with a Polygraph
• (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience with JavaScript
• (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience with web-based technologies, such as XML, HTML, or CSS
• (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience with relational databases
• (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience with the implementation and customization of ServiceNow modules
• (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience modifying ServiceNow tables
• (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience with the ServiceNow business rules and scripting aspects of the ServiceNow platform
• (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience performing administration duties in ServiceNow
• (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience troubleshooting problems in ServiceNow
• (Mandatory) Demonstrated experience providing integration and development support for external

Preferred:
• (Desired) Demonstrated experience using the Sponsors ServiceNow Platform
• (Desired) Demonstrated experience developing custom workflows in ServiceNow
